description:
Collect your Linux audit framework data and monitor the integrity of your files.


## Features and enhancements
- Build the input status report of Beat receivers in time linear in the number of inputs. #53723
- Update go-quark for quark 0.8 since-boot timestamps. Emitted events are unchanged. #52623
- Update go-quark for quark 0.9 boottime handling. Emitted events are unchanged. #53284

## Fixes
- Fix quadratic cost of building the receiver config for units with many streams. #53726 #53731
- Update Brotli to 1.2.7 to fix a decoder panic on malformed input. #54234
- Reduce retries and repeated error logs from Beat receivers while the output is unreachable. #54271
- Fix "ApiVersionsRequest V3" errors on Kafka broker connections by updating the Sarama fork. #54546
- Fix the auditd module failing or dropping events when immutable: true is set. #53707
- Stop Auditbeat add_session_metadata from stalling audit event reading after falling behind. #53853
- Fix the file_integrity module's kprobes backend failing on kernels that list .cold symbols first. #54106
- Fix Auditbeat file_integrity dropping all realtime events on macOS when recursive is false. #54279 #54257
- Fix the auditd module's lost event monitor leaking a socket and crashing without a client. #54645
- Fix the auditd module leaking a socket when it fails to create its data client. #54651 #54644
